plugins.name: siphrix-firewall
plugins.description: Record and risk-rank Claude Code tool calls with the Siphrix AI Action Audit & Risk Monitor. An audit-first PreToolUse overlay: every governed call is evaluated and recorded, risky verdicts surface as warnings, and nothing is blocked by default — blocking is a frozen opt-in (SIPHRIX_MODE=enforce). Siphrix never unblocks a call Claude Code would have gated.
